transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time on short notice. As you know, we've received a credible report that our authorized distributor routed some medical-device orders through an unfamiliar sub-distributor in a restricted market. No actions have been taken yet — no shipment suspension, no regulatory disclosure, no contractual notice, no termination decision. Before I approve any written response package, I need to hear from each of you on your respective areas. Let's start with sanctions: what is our exposure and what is your preliminary read? Then contracts on our rights and obligations, and finally client-operations on the hospital systems that depend on these devices.

transcript.text: I need to be direct with everyone. I completed transaction screening this morning and confirmed that two shipments went to an Iran-linked reseller not covered by any applicable OFAC general license. My report requires immediate suspension of distributor shipments and a voluntary OFAC disclosure filed within exactly 10 days. I have not circulated the report yet, but given where we are in this discussion, I need everyone to understand the gravity of what we're dealing with.
